title: CIVI: A Framework for Diagnosing Search Agent Failures in Civic Information
abstract: arXiv:2609.08094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in public-sector settings, where incorrect guidance can cause irreversible harm. We introduce CIVI, the first framework for diagnosing search agent failures in civic information. Its benchmark instantiation jointly spans cross-national, interjurisdictional government contexts (federal, state, and local) and functional categories from an internationally adopted United Nations standard. We evaluate ten frontier search agents and find that none matches an attentive human baseline. Alongside accuracy, CIVI measures search invocation rate, selective no-search accuracy, and how often agents cite authoritative government sources. To perform this diagnosis, we introduce ARISE, which decomposes agentic search failures into four mutually exclusive modes, isolated via source-injection ablation. ARISE attributes 72.1% of all observed failures to retrieval-bound causes rather than to gaps in the models'

translated_title: CIVI：一个用于诊断公民信息领域搜索智能体失败的框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署在公共部门场景中，在这些场景下，错误的指导可能造成不可逆转的伤害。我们提出了CIVI，这是第一个用于诊断公民信息领域搜索智能体失败的框架。其基准实例共同涵盖了跨国、跨司法管辖区的政府背景（联邦、州和地方层面），以及来自一项国际采用的联合国标准的功能类别。我们评估了十个前沿搜索智能体，发现没有一个能够匹敌细心的基线水平。除了准确性之外，CIVI还测量搜索调用率、选择性不搜索准确性，以及智能体引用权威政府来源的频率。为了进行这种诊断，我们引入了ARISE，它将智能体搜索失败分解为四种互斥的模式，并通过源注入消融实验进行隔离。ARISE将所有观察到的失败中的72.1%归因于检索受限的原因，而非模型自身能力的缺口。
tldr: 本文提出首个用于诊断公民信息领域搜索智能体失败的CIVI框架，发现十个前沿搜索智能体均不及细心的人类基线，并通过ARISE分析揭示72.1%的失败源于检索能力受限而非模型知识缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CIVI, the first framework for diagnosing search agent failures in civic information, finding that none of ten frontier search agents matches an attentive human baseline, with ARISE analysis attributing 72.1% of failures to retrieval-bound causes rather than model knowledge gaps.
